Job Description
A quantitative investment firm is seeking a  Machine Learning Research Engineer  to join a highly technical team focused on applying advanced machine learning techniques to complex, real-world problems. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys combining mathematical rigor with hands-on engineering and wants to see research evolve into practical, impactful solutions. 
The team values curiosity, experimentation, and thoughtful decision-making. Rather than forcing problems into a single framework, you'll evaluate multiple approaches, select the most appropriate methodology, and build well-structured solutions that deliver measurable results. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging machine learning initiatives while contributing to an evolving data and research platform.
Required Skills & Experience    Strong background in mathematics, statistics, optimization, or a related quantitative discipline  Experience applying machine learning techniques to solve complex business or research problems  Proficiency with Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, XGBoost, or similar technologies  Experience designing, testing, and implementing machine learning models  Ability to build and maintain organized, scalable research codebases  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  Experience evaluating multiple modeling approaches and selecting the best fit for a given problem  Ability to take projects from research and experimentation through production-ready implementation
  Desired Skills & Experience    Experience with reinforcement learning, neural networks, ensemble methods, gradient boosting, random forests, or genetic algorithms  GPU optimization and performance tuning experience  Familiarity with Spark and/or Databricks  Experience working within AWS or distributed computing environments  Exposure to large-scale data pipelines and machine learning infrastructure  Interest in quantitative finance, investing, or financial markets
  What You Will Be Doing
Daily Responsibilities    Research and evaluate machine learning techniques to solve challenging quantitative problems  Apply advanced mathematical concepts to feature engineering, model development, and optimization efforts  Explore new research papers and emerging technologies, translating ideas into practical experiments  Develop and maintain scalable machine learning systems and research tooling  Build clean, organized, and maintainable code that supports ongoing research efforts  Collaborate with engineers and researchers to improve data pipelines and platform capabilities  Utilize AI-assisted development tools responsibly while maintaining high standards for code quality and validation  Continuously experiment, iterate, and improve model performance based on quantitative results
  The Offer    Competitive base salary  Performance-based bonus opportunity  Exposure to cutting-edge machine learning research and engineering challenges  Collaborative and highly technical environment  Direct impact on research initiatives and technology strategy  Opportunity to work with modern cloud, distributed computing, and GPU-based technologies

As a Software Engineer on our Communication Safety team, you will join a high-impact team dedicated to detecting and mitigating unsafe communication across text and voice at a massive scale in real-time. Design, code, and test innovative capabilities within our core Communication Safety backend systems, navigating the full development lifecycle from initial design to production deployment.

Partner closely with the Communication product engineering teams to integrate our safety systems into the product experience, while working cross-functionally across Product Management, Policy, and Safety Ops teams to maintain high execution quality and pace.

Be mentored by senior engineers and actively engaged in architectural discussions and system design for our text and voice safety solutions.

Strong proficiency in C# or Python, with a readiness to learn how to build and maintain scalable, high-availability backend services.
Familiarity with the lifecycle of machine learning models, specifically around model serving, experimentation, and performance monitoring.
Experience participating in production incidents, and a passion for improving observability and recovery times in distributed systems.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product stakeholders to define requirements and deliver technical solutions.

WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?
The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and accuracy of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.
WHY TRUST & SAFETY?
With our large and growing number of active users on Roblox, we are an ever more attractive target for malicious actors to both compromise user accounts and proliferate fake accounts for the purposes of spam and phishing. Using a combination of machine learning and engineering, you'll develop new techniques and signals to help automatically identify repeated bad actors across a set of accounts as quickly as possible and identify common patterns to proactively prevent future abuse.
You Are :
Highly self-driven. You are perpetually curious and consistently strive to improve your skills by learning the latest modeling techniques and data tools. You thrive with freedom and autonomy and are excited by exploring new problem spaces.
A strong communicator. You understand that analysis must be presented in meaningful ways and engage in spirited discussions about the findings. You have the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and discuss appropriate tradeoffs.
Motivated by impact. You find great satisfaction in being able to point to direct contributions you've made to an organization. You recognize the inherent tradeoffs between further research/experimentation and productionization apply the appropriate methodology to maximize impact.
Experienced in developing models and interest in taking work from research to production. You are capable of using machine learning and statistical techniques to model a variety of different types of data from time-series and sequential data to unstructured data like text and images.
You Will :
Reporting to the Senior Director, you will accelerate product development through your understanding of the underlying data and your ability to partner with product and technical leaders to provide insights that lead to the safest experiences for Roblox's sizable user base.
Investigate new ways to discover automated behavior on the Roblox platform.
Develop modeling solutions to identify new attacks and signals of malicious user behavior.
Collaborate with engineering teams to push detection systems toward real-time identification.
Basic Qualifications :
Possess or pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Economics or other technical field
Experience in statistical modeling and machine learning
Experience with deep learning/modern ML techniques
Preferred Qualifications :
Problem Solving: Ability to frame ambiguous problems, designing analytical approaches, and solving open-ended data science problems that could drive business impact.
Training or fine-tuning machine learning models
